profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Splunk
profile.summary:
I am currently Software Engineer at Splunk. I was previously at Bloomberg, and interned at both Robinhood and Walmart.

I completed my M.S. in Computer Engineering at UCSD in March 2023. I also received my B.S. in Computer Engineering with a minor in Math at UCSD in June 2021.

Outside of software engineering, I do research in theoretical computer science.
